action.new:
def humanize(word: str) -> str:
    word = re.sub(r'id$', '', word)
    word = word.replace('_', ' ')
    word = re.sub(r'(?i)([a-z0-9]*)', lambda m: m.group(1).lower(), word)
    word = re.sub(r'(?i)^ ([a-z])', lambda m: m.group(1).upper(), word)
    return word
